tagline: A self-advised healthcare REIT investing in and owning healthcare facilities leased to healthcare operators under long-term net leases.
hero_kpi_rationale: As a REIT specialized in healthcare real estate, total revenue is the key KPI measuring operational performance and generation of rental cash flows. MPT does not operate in AI or cloud technologies; this KPI therefore directly reflects revenues from long-term leasing of healthcare facilities.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by healthcare real estate leasing and financing activities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the total rental and financing revenues for the fiscal year. MPT generated 972,022 thousand dollars in 2025, down 2.36% from 995,547 thousand dollars in 2024.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational performance for a healthcare REIT.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Annual interest charges on debt and financing obligations.
kpis.description: Interest expense totaled 510,362 thousand dollars in 2025, up 22.08% from 417,824 thousand dollars in 2024, reflecting higher interest rates.
kpis.signal: Measures the cost of debt financing and debt burden.

kpis.name: Real Estate Depreciation and Amortization
kpis.explanation: Annual depreciation and amortization charges on real estate assets.
kpis.description: Depreciation and amortization totaled 265,405 thousand dollars in 2025, a significant decline of 40.68% from 447,657 thousand dollars in 2024, following asset dispositions and portfolio reductions.
kpis.signal: Reflects the economic consumption of real estate assets over time.

kpis.name: Portfolio Size
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate properties in MPT's portfolio.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, MPT operates a portfolio of 384 properties, of which 373 are leased or financed to 52 operators in the healthcare sector.
kpis.signal: Indicator of real estate portfolio size and diversification.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss attributable to common shareholders of MPT.
kpis.description: MPT recorded a net loss attributable to common shareholders of 277,049 thousand dollars in 2025, a significant improvement of 88.49% from the loss of 2,408,287 thousand dollars in 2024, due to reduced depreciation charges.
kpis.signal: Measures the final net result after all expenses, taxes, and financing charges.

kpis.name: General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: General and administrative operating expenses of the company.
kpis.description: General and administrative expenses totaled 130,427 thousand dollars in 2025, down 2.51% from 133,789 thousand dollars in 2024.
kpis.signal: Reflects operational efficiency and control of administrative costs.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 15.0 billion euros in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 9.83 billion euros in the latest year.

risks.title: Adverse economic and geopolitical conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to economic crises, geopolitical conditions, inflation, interest rate fluctuations, and political changes. These factors could have an existential negative impact on financial condition and operating results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Tenant defaults and insolvency
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its 52 tenant operators to generate rental revenues. Restructurings of Prospect Medical Holdings and other tenants could impact investment recovery and cash flows. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Refinancing and credit availability risks
risks.score_rationale: The ability to refinance existing debt and obtain new financing depends on market conditions, interest rates, and credit ratings. Credit rating downgrades or capital market restrictions could compromise growth strategy. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Healthcare sector regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in the heavily regulated healthcare sector at federal, state, and local levels. Changes in Medicaid financing laws and other regulations could negatively affect tenants and company results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International investment risks
risks.score_rationale: MPT holds investments in Europe and South America, exposing the company to risks from foreign laws, currency fluctuations, and economic and political instability in these regions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: REIT status and tax risks
risks.score_rationale: MPT must maintain its REIT status in the United States and United Kingdom. Changes in federal, state, or local tax laws could affect this crucial tax advantage and shareholder distribution structure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Real estate impairment and asset constraints
risks.score_rationale: Net impairment charges reached 193,947 thousand dollars in 2025. Declines in real estate values could limit the ability to dispose of assets at attractive prices or obtain collateral-backed financing. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: MPT is a healthcare REIT specialized in healthcare real estate. The 10-K contains no information regarding its involvement or strategy in artificial intelligence or cloud computing.
